changelog:
Initial release of game-dev-release — comprehensive release management toolkit for game development.

- Provides end-to-end release checklists for planning, QA, builds, store submission, launch, hotfix, and patch notes
- Includes detailed document structure and templates for release plans, checklists, and patch notes history
- Outlines game launch and post-launch support workflows across multiple platforms (Steam, itch.io, Epic)
- Defines versioning strategies, hotfix processes, store submission steps, and key timelines
- Offers guidelines for patch notes, community communication, and platform-specific requirements
